messages.subject: Variance estimation
parts:
Hi,

I ran the BYM model with gaussian distribution:
Yi~N(Ui, sigma^2)
Ui=bo+ui+vi
ui~ ICAR model.
vi~N(0,sigma_v^2)

Here is the code:
formula_09 <- income_09_1~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym",graph=county.adj,scale.model=TRUE)
mod.income_09 <- inla(formula_09,family="gaussian",
                      data=county_data_09,keep=TRUE,
                      control.compute=list(dic=TRUE),
                      control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE))
summary(mod.income_09)
Model hyperparameters:
                                             mean        sd 0.025quant  0.5quant
Precision for the Gaussian observations 18683.467 1.840e+04  1240.8992 1.325e+04
Precision for ID (iid component)         1784.776 1.797e+03   110.8626 1.247e+03
Precision for ID (spatial component)        0.776 1.970e-02     0.7377 7.759e-01
                                        0.975quant      mode
Precision for the Gaussian observations  6.739e+04 3385.5811
Precision for ID (iid component)         6.572e+03  297.0554
Precision for ID (spatial component)     8.154e-01    0.7757

My question is how does the program to estimate "Precision for the Gaussian observations" and "Precision for ID (iid component)"?

These two variance (1/precision) components seem inseparable.

Thank you.
